criterion: User can complete primary goal without help
description: Register Cloud context requires a raw agent Actor ID, raw task IDs and raw sender Actor IDs in free-text fields, and none of these IDs is shown anywhere in the browser UI. Cora's profile shows no ID, and task IDs exist only in DOM attributes. Typing the display name 'Cora' fails with UNKNOWN_ACTOR 'Map a T3 thread to a registered agent Actor', which wrongly refers to T3 (flag #52).
expected: The same pickers as Map a T3 thread: an agent select (agents only, excluding T3-mapped ones), task checkboxes by title, sender checkboxes by name, and a project select.
actual: Seven free-text fields. A browser-only user cannot complete registration.
suggested_fix: Reuse the T3 mapping pickers in CloudControl, and fix the UNKNOWN_ACTOR message to be provider-neutral ('Choose a registered agent Actor').

description: The Cloud UI shows raw identifiers where T3 shows names: verdicts read 'human: accepted by actor-f2f93a24…c71c371a16', the Cloud task select lists 'task-0981e537…', executions are headed by a UUID ('968eae64-…· terminal'), and the agent is 'bc-f03c63a3-…'. Freshness uses ISO UTC ('Observed: 2026-11-09T20:05:49.416Z') and 'Fresh read / Stale / not observed', while T3 uses local time and 'Read 1s ago / Stale: last read …'.
expected: Display names, task titles, local times and one freshness vocabulary shared with T3.
actual: Two presentation systems for the same concepts.
suggested_fix: Resolve Actor and task names from the board doc in CloudControl, and reuse ControlPane's freshness and time formatting.

description: An SSH repository URL is refused with a bare 'Invalid URL' (ERR_INVALID_URL) instead of 'Use a credential-free HTTPS repository URL'. A short commit hash is refused with 'Full commit hash, diff bytes and test evidence required', which does not say which input is wrong. Both appear off-screen and briefly (F-111-01).
expected: Field-specific messages next to the field: 'Use the HTTPS URL, e.g. https://github.com/raman/atlas-billing' and 'Enter the full 40-character commit hash'.
actual: Generic or combined messages in the pane banner.
suggested_fix: Validate the URL scheme before new URL(), and validate each evidence field separately, reporting which one failed.

description: With dispatch disabled, Save Cloud intent succeeds with no warning, and the queued execution shows no reason. 'Live Cloud dispatch disabled' appears on the row only after it is cancelled. After 'Accept Cloud result', the evidence textarea is not cleared (T3's equivalent clears).
expected: A queued row says 'Waiting: live Cloud dispatch is disabled on this service'. The form clears after a successful verdict.
actual: Silent queueing, and a form that keeps its text.
suggested_fix: Render the dispatch-blocked reason for queued rows, and reset the verdict form on success.
